chapters.title: Two heaps: by capital, by profit

frames.caption: Start with capital w = 0 and pick up to k = 3 projects. Each project needs capital c and returns profit p. Locked projects wait in a min-heap by capital.
With w = 0, unlock every project with capital ≤ 0: c0:p1.
Project 1: take the most profitable affordable one (c0:p1). Capital grows to 1.
With w = 1, unlock every project with capital ≤ 1: c1:p2, c1:p3.
Project 2: take the most profitable affordable one (c1:p3). Capital grows to 4.
With w = 4, unlock every project with capital ≤ 4: c3:p5.
Project 3: take the most profitable affordable one (c3:p5). Capital grows to 9.
Final capital 9. Each project moves between heaps at most once: O(n log n).
